proposed_statement_changes.reason: The coverage and noncontraction clauses are proved, but the unconditional local root-\(n\) diameter clause is too strong under the frozen definition of \(\operatorname{Out}_N\). That definition requires only containment and permits, for example, the valid rational output \( [\lfloor x-r\rfloor-1,\lceil x+r\rceil+1]\), whose excess width does not vanish. A root-\(n\) local diameter requires an additional rounding-excess condition or a precision schedule, neither of which is declared. The proposed claim removes only that unsupported ancillary rate clause.
